# Dataset preparation



## NHANES dataset 11-12

```{r, 11_12}
demographicG <- nhanes('DEMO_G')
medicalConditionsG <- nhanes('MCQ_G')
cognitiveFunctionG <- nhanes('CFQ_G')
bloodMetalG <- nhanes('PBCD_G')
urineMetalG <- nhanes('UHM_G')
diabetesG <- nhanes('DIQ_G')
smokingCigaretteG <- nhanes('SMQ_G')
bmiG <- nhanes('BMX_G')
bloodPressureCholesterolG <- nhanes('BPQ_G')
alcoholUseG <- nhanes('ALQ_G')
```



## NHANES dataset 13-14

```{r, 13-14}
demographicH <- nhanes('DEMO_H')
medicalConditionsH <- nhanes('MCQ_H')
cognitiveFunctionH <- nhanes('CFQ_H')
bloodMetalH <- nhanes('PBCD_H')
urineMetalH <- nhanes('UM_H')
diabetesH <- nhanes('DIQ_H')
smokingCigaretteH <- nhanes('SMQ_H')
bmiH <- nhanes('BMX_H')
bloodPressureCholesterolH <- nhanes('BPQ_H')
alcoholUseH <- nhanes('ALQ_H')
```



## Append files

```{r, append}
demographicInfo_df <- bind_rows(demographicG, demographicH) 
diabetesInfo_df <- bind_rows(diabetesG, diabetesH)
smokingInfo_df <- bind_rows(smokingCigaretteG, smokingCigaretteH)
alcoholInfo_df <- bind_rows(alcoholUseG, alcoholUseH)
bloodPressureCholesterolInfo_df <- bind_rows(bloodPressureCholesterolG, bloodPressureCholesterolH)
bmiInfo_df <- bind_rows(bmiG, bmiH)
bloodMetalInfo_df <- bind_rows(bloodMetalG, bloodMetalH)
urineMetalInfo_df <- bind_rows(urineMetalG, urineMetalH)
cognitiveInfo_df <- bind_rows(cognitiveFunctionG, cognitiveFunctionH)
medicalInfo_df <- bind_rows(medicalConditionsG, medicalConditionsH)
```



## Re-code files

```{r, demographic_data}
demographicInfo_df <- demographicInfo_df  %>% 
  mutate(
    # "Male" = 1, "Female" = 0
    GENDER = case_when(
      RIAGENDR == 1 ~ "Male",
      RIAGENDR == 2 ~ "Female"
    ),
     # "0 - 59" = 99, "60 - 64" = 0, "65–69" = 1, "70–74" = 2, "75-79" = 3, ">= 80" = 4
     # AGE = case_when(
     #   RIDAGEYR <= 59 ~ 99,
     #   RIDAGEYR >= 60 & RIDAGEYR <= 64 ~ 0,
     #   RIDAGEYR >= 65 & RIDAGEYR <= 69 ~ 1,
     #   RIDAGEYR >= 70 & RIDAGEYR <= 74 ~ 2,
     #   RIDAGEYR >= 75 & RIDAGEYR <= 79 ~ 3,
     #   RIDAGEYR >= 80 ~ 4
     # ),
    # "mexican american" = 1, "other Hispanic" = 2, "non hispanic white" = 3, "non hispanic black" = 4, "other race" = 5
    RACE = case_when(
      RIDRETH1 == 1 ~ "Mexican American",
      RIDRETH1 == 2 ~ "Other Hispanic",
      RIDRETH1 == 3 ~ "Non Hispanic White",
      RIDRETH1 == 4 ~ "Non Hispanic Black",
      RIDRETH1 == 5 ~ "Other Race"
    ),
    # "married" = 1, "widowed" = 2, "divorced" = 3, "separated" = 4, "never married" = 0, "living with partner" = 6, "refused" = 99, "unknown" = 99 
    MARTLS = case_when(
      DMDMARTL == 1 ~ "Married",
      DMDMARTL == 2 ~ "Widowed",
      DMDMARTL == 3 ~ "Divorced",
      DMDMARTL == 4 ~ "Separated",
      DMDMARTL == 5 ~ "Never Married",
      DMDMARTL == 6 ~ "Living with Partner",
      DMDMARTL == 77 ~ "unknown",
      DMDMARTL == 99 ~ "unknown"
    ),
    # "<High school" = 1, "High school" = 2; ">High school" = 3, "unknown" = 99, "refused" = 99
    EDUCL = case_when(
      DMDEDUC2 <= 2 ~ "<High School",
      DMDEDUC2 == 3 ~ "High School",
      DMDEDUC2 > 3 & DMDEDUC2 <=5 ~ ">High School",
      DMDEDUC2 == 7 ~ "unknown",
      DMDEDUC2 == 9 ~ "unknown"
    ) 
  ) %>% 
  select(
    SEQN, GENDER, RIDAGEYR , RACE, EDUCL, MARTLS, INDFMPIR, WTINT2YR, WTMEC2YR, SDMVSTRA, SDMVPSU
  ) %>% 
  rename(AGE = RIDAGEYR, PRTIO = INDFMPIR)
```

```{r, medical_conditions}
medicalInfo_df <- medicalInfo_df %>% 
  mutate(
    # "yes" = 1, "no" = 0, "unknown" = 99, "refused" = 1
    STROKE = case_when(
      MCQ160F == 1 ~ "Yes",
      MCQ160F == 2 ~ "No",
      MCQ160F == 7 ~ "Yes",
      MCQ160F == 9 ~ "unknown"
    ),
    # "yes" = 1, "no" = 0, "unknown" = 99, "refused" = 1
    HATTACK = case_when(
      MCQ160E == 1 ~ "Yes",
      MCQ160E == 2 ~ "No",
      MCQ160E == 7 ~ "Yes",
      MCQ160E == 9 ~ "unknown"
    ) 
  ) %>% 
  select(SEQN, STROKE, HATTACK)
```

```{r, diabetes}
diabetesInfo_df <- diabetesInfo_df %>% 
  mutate(
    # "yes" = 1, "no" = 0, "borderline" = 2, "unknown" = 99
    DIABETES = case_when(
      DIQ010 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      DIQ010 == 2 ~ "No",
      DIQ010 == 3 ~ "Borderline",
      DIQ010 == 7 ~ "unknown",
      DIQ010 == 9 ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(SEQN, DIABETES) 
```

```{r, smoking_cigarette}
smokingInfo_df <- smokingInfo_df %>% 
  mutate(
    # "current" = 1,  "former" = 2, "never" = 0
    SMQS = case_when(
      SMQ020 == 2 ~ "Never",
      SMQ020 == 1 & SMQ040 == 1 ~ "Current",
      SMQ020 == 1 & SMQ040 == 2 ~ "Current",
      SMQ020 == 1 & SMQ040 == 3 ~ "Former",
      SMQ020 == 7 ~ "Current",
      SMQ040 == 7 ~ "Current",
      SMQ020 == 9 ~ "unknown",
      SMQ020 == 9 ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(SEQN, SMQS)
```

```{r, bmi}
bmiInfo_df <- bmiInfo_df %>% 
  # mutate(
  #   # "<18.5" = 1, "18.5–24.9" = 2,  "25–29.9" = 3, "30+" = 4
  #   BMI = case_when(
  #     BMXBMI < 18.5 ~ 1,
  #     BMXBMI >= 18.5 & BMXBMI < 25 ~ 2,
  #     BMXBMI >= 25 & BMXBMI <= 29.9 ~ 3,
  #     BMXBMI > 29.9 ~ 4
  #   )
  # ) %>% 
   select(SEQN, BMXBMI) %>% 
  rename(BMI = BMXBMI)
 
```

```{r, blood_pressure_cholesterol_total}
bloodPressureCholesterolInfo_df <- bloodPressureCholesterolInfo_df  %>% 
  mutate(
    # "yes" = 1, "no" = 0, "unknown" = 99
    BPS = case_when(
      BPQ020 == 1 ~ "yes",
      BPQ020 == 2 ~ "No",
      BPQ020 == 7 ~ "unknown",
      BPQ020 == 9 ~ "unknown"
    ),
    BCS = case_when(
      BPQ080 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      BPQ080 == 2 ~ "No",
      BPQ080 == 7 ~ "unknown",
      BPQ080 == 9 ~ "unknown"
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(SEQN, BPS, BCS)
```

```{r, alcohol_use}
alcoholInfo_df <- alcoholInfo_df %>% 
  filter(ALQ101 == 1) %>% 
  select(SEQN, ALQ120Q) %>% 
  rename(ALQS = ALQ120Q) %>% 
  mutate(
    ALQS = recode(ALQS, "777" = 99, "999" = 99)
  )
```

```{r, blood_heavy_metal}
bloodMetalInfo_df <- bloodMetalInfo_df %>% 
  mutate(LBXBPB = LBXBPB * 10) %>% 
  select(SEQN, LBXBPB, LBXBCD, LBXTHG, LBXBSE, LBXBMN) %>% 
  rename(BLEAD = LBXBPB, 
    BCADMIUM = LBXBCD,
    BMERCURY = LBXTHG,
    BSELEUM = LBXBSE, 
    BMANGE = LBXBMN
  ) 
```

```{r,urine_heavy_metal}
urineMetalInfo_df <- urineMetalInfo_df %>% 
  select(
    SEQN, URXUBA, URXUCD, URXUCO, URXUMN, URXUPB, URXUSN, URXUSR, URXUUR
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    UBARIUM = URXUBA,
    UCADMIUM = URXUCD,
    UCOBALT = URXUCO,
    UMANGE = URXUMN,
    ULEAD = URXUPB,
    UTIN = URXUSN,
    USTOUM = URXUSR,
    UURANIUM = URXUUR
  )
```

```{r, cognitive-function}
cognitiveInfo_df <- cognitiveInfo_df %>% 
  filter(CFASTAT == 1 & CFDCCS == 1) %>% 
  mutate(
    CERADIM = (CFDCST1 + CFDCST2 + CFDCST3) / 3
  ) %>% 
  select(
  SEQN, CERADIM, CFDCSR, CFDAST, CFDDS
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    CERADDR = CFDCSR,
    AFT = CFDAST,
    DST = CFDDS
  )
```



## Merge all files

```{r, merge}
cognitiveProject_df <- 
  left_join(cognitiveInfo_df, demographicInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., diabetesInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>% 
  left_join(., smokingInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., alcoholInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., bloodPressureCholesterolInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., bmiInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., bloodMetalInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
   left_join(., urineMetalInfo_df, by = 'SEQN') %>%
  left_join(., medicalInfo_df, by = 'SEQN')
```

## Select required variables

```{r, variable-selection}
cognitiveData_df <- cognitiveProject_df %>% 
  group_by(EDUCL) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(CERADIM, CERADDR, AFT, DST), ~(scale(.) %>% as.vector)) %>% 
  mutate(
    CSCORE = (CERADIM + CERADDR + AFT + DST)/4
  ) %>% 
  # mutate(
  #   CSTATUS = case_when(
  #     # "low" = 1, "high" = 0
  #     CSCORE <= -1 ~ 0,
  #     CSCORE > -1 ~ 1
  #   )
  # ) %>% 
  mutate(
    EDUCL = na_if(EDUCL, "unknown"),
    DIABETES = na_if(DIABETES, "unknown"),
    HATTACK = na_if(HATTACK, "unknown"),
    STROKE = na_if(STROKE, "unknown"),
    MARTLS = na_if(MARTLS, "unknown"),
    BPS = na_if(BPS, "unknown"),
    BCS = na_if(BCS, "unknown"),
    SMQS = na_if(SMQS, "unknown"),
    WTMEC4YR = WTMEC2YR/2,
    # Define indicator for analysis population of interest: adults aged 60 and over with a valid cognitive status value
    inAnalysis = (AGE >= 60 & !is.na(CSCORE))
  )  %>%
  select(
    SEQN, GENDER, AGE, MARTLS, PRTIO, RACE, EDUCL, BPS, BCS, DIABETES,
    BMI, ALQS, SMQS, STROKE, HATTACK, BLEAD, BCADMIUM, BMERCURY, BSELEUM,
    BMANGE, UBARIUM, UCADMIUM, UCOBALT, UMANGE, ULEAD, UTIN, USTOUM, UURANIUM, 
    CSCORE, WTMEC4YR, SDMVSTRA, SDMVPSU, inAnalysis
  ) %>%
  mutate_at(
    vars(
      GENDER, MARTLS, RACE,  EDUCL, BPS, BCS, DIABETES, SMQS, STROKE, HATTACK, 
      SDMVPSU
    ),
    factor
  )
```



## Define Survey Design for covariates

```{r, survy-design}
# Define survey design for overall dataset
cognitiveSurveyDesign_svyd  <- svydesign(
  data = cognitiveData_df, 
  ids = ~SDMVPSU, 
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC4YR, 
  nest = TRUE,
  survey.lonely.psu = "adjust"
)
cognitiveSurveyData_svyd <- subset(cognitiveSurveyDesign_svyd, inAnalysis)
```




# Data analysis



## Descresptive statistics

```{r, summary}
cognitiveSurveyData_df <- cognitiveSurveyData_svyd[["variables"]] %>%
  tibble()

cognitiveSurveyData_df[, 2:28] %>%  tbl_summary(
   
    statistic = list(
        all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    missing_text = "(Missing)"
) %>%
    modify_caption("**Baseline Characteristics from NHANES 2011–2014, of Adults 
More Than 60 Years Old**") %>%
    bold_labels()

cognitiveSurveyData_df  %>%
  summarise_all(list(~is.na(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variables", values_to="missing"
  ) %>%
  count(variables, missing) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = n,
      y = variables,
      fill=missing
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("navy", "gold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Missinig Values",
    x = "Proportion",
    y = "Variables"
  ) +
  geom_col(position = "fill")
```



## Scale transformation of metals

```{r}
cognitiveScaleData_df <- cognitiveSurveyData_df %>% 
  mutate_at(
    vars(
      BLEAD, BCADMIUM, BMERCURY, BSELEUM,BMANGE, UBARIUM, UCADMIUM, UCOBALT,
      UMANGE, ULEAD, UTIN, USTOUM, UURANIUM
    ), ~(scale(.) %>% as.vector)
  ) 
```


## Create testing and training datasets for blood metals

```{r}
# Create a column based on missing values
bloodDataInd <- cognitiveScaleData_df %>% 
  select(
    GENDER, AGE, MARTLS, PRTIO, RACE, EDUCL, BPS, BCS, DIABETES, BMI, ALQS, 
    SMQS, STROKE, HATTACK, BLEAD, BCADMIUM, BMERCURY, BSELEUM, BMANGE, CSCORE
  ) %>% 
  mutate(indicator = +if_any(everything(), is.na)) 
```


### Testing data (Data with no missing values) for blood metals

```{r}
# Data for bkmr analysis
bloodBKMR <- bloodDataInd %>% 
  filter(indicator == 0)
```


### Training data (Data with missing values) for blood metals

```{r}
bloodMetalMissing <- bloodDataInd %>% 
  filter(indicator == 1)
```

#### Blood metlas BKMR analysis data

```{r}
# Create a column based on metals missing values
bloodMetalInd <- bloodMetalMissing %>% 
  mutate(missInd = +if_any(c(BLEAD, BCADMIUM, BMERCURY, BSELEUM,BMANGE), is.na)) 
```

```{r}
bloodLasso <- bloodMetalInd %>% 
  filter(missInd == 0) %>% 
  select(CSCORE, BLEAD, BCADMIUM, BMERCURY, BSELEUM, BMANGE) 
```
